library.title: Library
library.empty: Import a folder or ZIP file with a Commander Keen game to get started.

runtime.title: Game engine
runtime.needed: BloogBase runs the games in DOSBox Staging, a free DOS emulator. It's downloaded once from its official website.
runtime.notInstalled: DOSBox Staging is not installed yet.
runtime.activeManaged: Using DOSBox Staging {{version}}, installed by BloogBase.
runtime.customHint: For advanced users. It has to be DOSBox Staging; other DOSBox versions can't keep your saves separate from the game files.
runtime.chooseInSettings: Choose an existing DOSBox Staging in the settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rerunHint: Download DOSBox and the free episodes, or add games from Steam and GOG.

errors.noGamesFound: No Commander Keen games were found there.
errors.unsupportedSource: Please choose a folder or a ZIP file.
errors.archive: The archive could not be read.
errors.network: The download didn't work. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.checksumMismatch: The downloaded file was damaged or changed, so it wasn't used. Please try again.
errors.unsupportedPlatform: There's no DOSBox Staging download for your system. You can choose an existing installation instead.
errors.runtimeMissing: DOSBox Staging is needed to play. Download it first.
errors.invalidRuntime: That doesn't look like DOSBox Staging ({{message}}).
errors.invalidLocation: BloogBase can't keep its data there ({{message}}).
errors.noModFound: No Commander Keen mod was found there.
errors.incompatibleInstall: The mod doesn’t fit that game ({{message}}).
errors.missingGame: This mod needs {{message}}. Add it to your library first.
errors.badSignature: The mod list couldn't be verified, so it wasn't used.

setup.offline: You seem to be offline. Downloads need an internet connection; you can skip them and add games from your computer instead.

welcome.title: Welcome to BloogBase!
welcome.intro: BloogBase is a home for Commander Keen: your games and saves in one place, started with a single click.
welcome.steps: A few quick steps and you're ready to play. You can skip any of them and run the setup again from the settings.

storage.title: Where to keep your games
storage.intro: BloogBase keeps your games, saved games and DOSBox in this folder:
storage.usage: That needs about 150 MB. Most of it is DOSBox; each game only takes a few MB.
storage.locked: The folder can't be changed anymore because there are already games in it.
storage.restarting: BloogBase restarts to use the new folder…

engine.title: Game engine
engine.continue: You can continue while it downloads.

episodes.title: Free episodes
episodes.intro: These episodes were released as shareware and are free to play. Mods made for them work right away.
episodes.terms: BloogBase downloads the original, unmodified shareware releases from public archives (archive.org, textfiles.com). Shareware may be shared freely, but never sold.

owned.title: Already own Keen?
owned.intro: Episodes 2, 3, 5 and 6 were never free. If you bought them on Steam or GOG, BloogBase can add them from there.
owned.scanning: Looking for games from Steam and GOG…
owned.noneFound: No Commander Keen games from Steam or GOG were found on this computer.
owned.other: Have the games somewhere else? Add them from a folder or ZIP file:
owned.buy: Where can I buy the other episodes?

done.title: All set!
done.running: Downloads keep running in the background. Your games show up in the library as soon as they're ready.

mods.title: Try a mod
mods.intro: Fans have made many new adventures for Commander Keen. These work with your games:
mods.none: There are no suggestions for your games right now. Once you have a game, you'll find mods under Discover.
mods.later: You'll find many more under Discover.

mods.addHint: Choose a mod the way you downloaded it: a ZIP file or an unpacked folder. BloogBase finds out which game it is for and how to start it.
mods.name: Name
mods.helpHint: This mod can be started in more than one way. If you are not sure, keep the first one; the mod’s readme may tell you more.

recipe.episode: Start the original game with the mod’s files

mods.missingGame: This mod needs {{game}}. Add it from Steam, GOG or a folder first.
mods.missingGame_version: This mod needs {{game}} ({{versions}}). Add it from Steam, GOG or a folder first.
mods.versionUnchecked: BloogBase doesn’t know this version of the game, so it can’t check whether the mod fits. Give it a try!
mods.assumedVersion: This mod doesn’t say which version of the game it needs. Most mods for this episode are made for {{version}}, but yours is {{yours}}, so it may not work properly.
mods.modifiedGame: This copy of the game was changed (for example, its copy protection was removed). Mods that patch the game are usually made for the original and may not work with it.
mods.removeHint: The mod’s files are deleted. The game itself stays in your library.
mods.keepSaves_one: Keep the saved game as a backup
mods.keepSaves_other: Keep the {{count}} saved games as a backup

discover.title: Discover
discover.neverChecked: The mod list hasn't been loaded yet.
discover.hidden_one: Update BloogBase to see {{count}} more mod.
discover.hidden_other: Update BloogBase to see {{count}} more mods.
discover.offline: Showing the mod list from your last visit. {{message}}
discover.empty: The mod list couldn't be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
